rv.q: This piece of new writing is not just able to conjure complex and captivating characters, but presents a gripping plot that kept me intrigued throughout.
Act of God is a masterclass in acting and storytelling, and the commitment and passion of the creatives and actors is a wonderful gift to the audience.
Act of God promises an intimate psychological confrontation, but despite two compelling performances, its theatrical ambition is undermined by muddled storytelling and restrictive staging.

cn.t: This intimate two-hander exploring morality and masculinity features compelling, committed performances, but its psychological ambitions are undermined by muddled execution and unclear focus.
